summary.en: Conan and the Detective Boys meet spider researchers who are taking pictures of a Redback spider. One of them calls their professor, but upon hearing him panic on the phone, they rush to the facility to find their professor fallen to a deadly poisonous spider. Location: Beika Agriculture University Victim: Yutaka Shinno Cause of death: Poison from spider bite Suspects: Tooru Itokawa, Yoshiki Urasaki, and Miwa Yasuda
